citation: Parvaresh Rizi E, et al. Meal rich in carbohydrate, but not protein or fat, reveals adverse immunometabolic responses associated with obesity. Nutr J 2016.
protocol: 10 h fast; 600 kcal liquid mixed meal (high carbohydrate, high fat or high protein, random order); samples 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360 min
population: 9 lean insulin-sensitive and 9 obese insulin-resistant men
note: Six-hour sampling after three printed meals, lean men printed separately; the curves look figure-only, so the reader may refuse for lack of printed numbers.
